courses.title: ToolTest 1 - Gumball
courses.objective: Use the on-model Gumball for direct move, plane move, rotate and scale, then compare with numeric editing.

steps.title: Create and select a reference body
steps.learn: Create and select a reference body
steps.instructions: Create a clearly asymmetric body and select it.
steps.expectedResult: The body is selected and its orientation is obvious.

checkpoint.expected: The body is selected and its orientation is obvious.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Enable Gumball
validationChecks: Gumball is visible for the active selection
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Move using arrows
steps.expectedResult: The selection translates along one axis.

checkpoint.expected: The selection translates along one axis.

validationChecks: Movement is constrained to the selected axis
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Move in a plane
steps.expectedResult: The selection translates in the selected plane.

checkpoint.expected: The selection translates in the selected plane.

validationChecks: Movement stays in the selected plane
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Rotate with a ring
steps.expectedResult: The selection rotates about the chosen Gumball axis.

checkpoint.expected: The selection rotates about the chosen Gumball axis.

validationChecks: Rotation occurs about the intended axis
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Scale with cube handles
steps.instructions: Drag a scale cube; repeat with Shift for uniform scaling.
steps.expectedResult: The selection scales; Shift produces uniform scale.

checkpoint.expected: The selection scales; Shift produces uniform scale.

validationChecks: Non-uniform scale changes the chosen direction
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Use numeric Gumball
steps.instructions: Enter exact move/rotate/scale values and apply.
steps.expectedResult: The model updates to the exact numeric transform.

checkpoint.expected: The model updates to the exact numeric transform.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.
